payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate i from 0 to k, representing armor upgrades; compute resulting health and attack; check if character kills monster before dying. This enumerates all distributions of coins.
payload.rationale: The solution loops over one parameter to exhaust all upgrade splits. This is brute force complete search. Among offered subtypes, search_backtracking is the most generic exhaustive search label, though no recursion or backtracking occurs.
